application_sentences: nter features the InForce 1000 actuator for performing nanoindentation tests and universal nanomechanical tests, and can optionally add the InForce 50 actuator to test softer materials.
A diamond Berkovich tip (Synton-MDP, Switzerland) was used for the nanoindentation tests.
The iMicro has also been used for his initila development of high strain rate nanoindentation.

Interchangeable actuators provide a large dynamic range of force and displacement, allowing researchers to test materials from soft polymers to hard metals and ceramics with accuracy and repeatability.
The iMicro nanoindenter is well-suited for testing a wide range of battery materials, from soft lithium to hard ceramic substrates.
CSM is also used for other advanced measurement options, including the ProbeDMA™ method for storage and loss modulus measurements and AccuFilm™ substrate-independent measurements.
